Senses.Explanation: Literally, 'that bank/side,' hence 'that side,' 'the other side,' or 'beyond.' The allowlisted record has 786 occurrences in 220 texts. The deictic contrast is explicit: questions set 'the matter on that side' (那畔事) against 'the matter on this side' (者邊事), and one exchange says that as soon as words are involved one falls on 'this side' (遮畔) before asking for news from 'that side' (那畔底消息). The word builds noun phrases for a matter, person, saying, road, or news located on that side. Its most frequent fixed expansion is 'beyond Awesome Sound' (威音那畔), which occurs in addresses and verses; other recurrent forms include 'the matter beyond Awesome Sound' (威音那畔事), 'a person beyond Awesome Sound' (威音那畔人), and 'a saying from beyond Awesome Sound' (威音那畔一句). A funeral address asks, 'what is the road on that side?' (如何是那畔路). These are the corpus's locative and attributive deployments; the entry does not replace 'that side' with an imported category.
Senses.Note: Corpus counts: 786 hits in 220 texts. 'Beyond Awesome Sound' (威音那畔) has 419 hits in 161 texts; 'the matter on that side' (那畔事), 33/25; 'a person on that side' (那畔人), 10/7; 'a saying on that side' (那畔一句), 4/3; 'what is that side...?' (如何是那畔), 5/5; and 'one on that side' (那畔者), 4/4. Searches for 'X means that side,' 'is called that side,' and related equation formulas returned no Chinese Chan definition. Evidence outside the Chinese record was excluded.
